subject: geom_segment to edge of plot with scale_x_log10

messages.author: 6a95d2ee62a86e9f
messages.subject: geom_segment to edge of plot with scale_x_log10
parts:
Setting x to -Inf works in geom_segment to give a line off the plot, with scale_x_continuous().  But, if I try to put x on a log scale with scale_x_log10(), the segment disappears (presumably because of the implied log10(-Inf).  Is there another way to do this?  In standard R graphics, I'd be using par("usr") to do this.

Woody
